BiblicalUsage: Epipothia is great desire, intense longing — and Paul says, having a great desire these many years to come unto you, whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you.
TheologicalSignificance: Years of desire, carried patiently until the road opens: Paul's longing to visit Rome shows the apostle's heart.
